test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.**

After the rain stopped, the air smelled fresh and clean, and the sun ________ (stared) out from behind the clouds.
solution: The correct answer is: **Peeked** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **Stared **means to look fixedly or intently at something. (किसी चीज़ को स्थिर या ध्यान से देखना) • **Example**: *Samantha stared at the intricate painting on the wall, studying every detail.* • Marked option **Peeked **means to look quickly or furtively. (तेज़ी से या छुपकर देखना) • **Example**: *Mark quickly peeked through the slightly open door to see if anyone was inside the room.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Observed **means to watch carefully or take notice of something. (किसी चीज़ को ध्यान से देखना या ध्यान देना) • **Spied **means to secretly watch or observe someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को गुप्त रूप से देखना या निरीक्षण करना) • **Surveyed **means to examine or inspect something thoroughly. (किसी चीज़ की गहनता से जाँच या निरीक्षण करना) 38:T8af, The correct answer is: **Raze**
